scenario_title: Feature flag enabled a dormant code path
title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-08-13 14:29-17:19: api-gateway: 196 of 249 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-13 14:29 and 2026-08-13 17:19 UTC (peak error ratio 0.93 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. _templates.macro: Config change turned {key} on, activating a code path shipped days earlier.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}), deployed in {culprit_event}, runs only when the flag is on and skips the safety check of the old path.
_templates.remediation: Turn feature.fast_ack off again in config/storage-svc.yaml; fix the flag-guarded branch at {file}:{line} before re-enabling.
